rules.why: The radio is the native input inside its <label>, with a name that groups the question.
Only the native input is a radio; role="radio" needs JS the AL does not ship.
The visible label is the accessible name.
The dot is paint; the input already announces the state.

manual.why: All radios of a name live in one <fieldset> with a visible <legend>: the legend is the question.
A name has two radios or more - a lone radio can't be unchecked.
The error goes on the fieldset (aria-describedby to the message), never on each radio.
